name: Dark Alley
desc1: This rancid alleyway is claustrophobic and unsettling. Trash is ankle-
desc2: deep on the ground, and occasionally something squishy and wet can be
desc3: felt underfoot. Bloodstains are frequent on the crumbling walls,
desc4: adding a certain je-ne-sais-quoi to this fine place. To the west, a
desc5: tall iron fence leads into a dark, frightening park, and to the east
desc6: stands a barred, gloomy institution. The alley continues to the north
